reason: This is a planner-core framework change that alters when plan cache can be disabled during optimization, and it spans central optimizer paths: cacheability checking, logical datasource handling, physical index scan, index join/index merge path generation, and best-task selection. Even without SQL/parser/session file changes, plan-cache gating inside optimization has broad blast radius for plan correctness and reuse semantics, and mistakes here can cause wrong-plan reuse or silent regressions across many query shapes.
